conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentrates on safer assets, aiming for low drawdowns. Expect slower growth due to de-risking.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs to reduce overall risk.

Add a new, high-scoring Energy position (COP).
Maintain a moderate cash buffer.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly return by managing risk first. It blends broad market exposure with quality tech and a small allocation to leveraged ETFs. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs in Semiconductors and Space.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for higher growth (target ~4%/mo) by increasing leverage and concentration. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risks of leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage rapid losses.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs to zero.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly return through distributions. It minimizes leverage and high-beta single names, prioritizing stable income generation and low drawdowns. NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
